notes.title: Update 1.2.1 News (Patch Notes + Mac and Linux Bugs)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h1]

Firstly, we want to apologize for the sparse notes regarding releases lately. We have a big announcement coming soon!

Second, it recently came to our attention that the game was "available" on Mac and Linux. We would like to clarify that this is false. It was an issue in the backend of Steam. The bug has since been patched along with some others.

Please remember to stay tuned for a huge announcement coming up!

[b]Thank you,
The Raccoon[/b]


[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that forced saves to save via XML (unreported)
[*] Fixed [b]24c4[/b] - Corporation Bug
[*] Fixed [b]59a1[/b] - Linux + Mac Display Bug
[*] Fixed [b]18k1[/b], [b]32t1[/b], [b]92b2[/b] - All Related to Save Games
[*] Fixed [b]24c2[/b] - Trade Bug
[/list]

notes.title: Cloud Saves Now Live!
notes.content:
Great news! Cloud Saves are now live!

For the past month, we've had outstanding members of the community test the be-jesus out of the new Cloud Saves feature. They searched every nook and cranny to help make the Cloud Saves useable, functional, and available for everyone. 

Thanks to the following people for their effort in testing Cloud Saves:
[list]
[*] TheRealOG
[*] TomBoisBeLike
[*] Trexismany
[*] Connan
[*] Albatross
[/list]
A big thanks to all of you for your continued support of Apollo4x!

Thanks again,
Raccoon

notes.title: More Apollo4x Community News!
notes.content:
Hey to the 4x'ers, 

Raccoon here, and today I've got some more news about the Apollo4x community and what we're planning on doing.
[list]
[*] [b]Live Q&A[/b]
The team will be hosting a live Q&A session on July 7th at 5:00 PM EST. So be sure to tune in! You can learn more about it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/365420/events/106181181426828876]here[/url]

[*] [b]Trading Cards[/b]
You may be asking yourself, "Where did the trading cards go? It's been weeks!" We've also been asking ourselves that, and as it turns out we never submitted them for review! We apologize and would like to remind you that they'll be heading out by the end of the week.

[*] [b]Cloud Saves[/b]
For the past month, our AWESOME and I mean AWESOME community moderators and dedicated Apollo4x fans have been testing out the Cloud Saves feature, and we're happy to announce that it'll be available to everyone by the end of the week as we tweak a few things.
[/list]

[quote]
[h1]The DigiEnt and Dog Rescue Charity[/h1]
I'd like to take a moment to remind everyone about The DigiEnt and Dog Rescue Charity. While not many people may know this, a whole 10% of all profits from the game will go to rescuing sheltered dogs that would be killed without the super cool DigiEnt president Mike Young flying out and moving them to Non-kill shelters. Thanks guys!
[/quote]

That's it from the Apollo4x team for this week!

See you in the community,
The Raccoon

notes.title: New Updates to the Apollo4x Community!
notes.content:
Hello all you 4x'ers,

Raccoon here, and today I've got some special news! You guessed it! We're rolling out some new and major features of the Apollo4x Community!
[list]
[*] [b]Cloud Saves[/b] - We'll be rolling out Cloud Saves to a few members of the community, so we can identify any bugs that might arise with the new implementation.
[*] [b]Trading Cards[/b] - We have the trading cards ready, so start your space drives! We'll be pushing them live in the upcoming days!
[*] [b]Badges[/b] - With Great Trading Cards... Comes Great Badges! We'll have those ready in just a few days!
[*] [b]Backgrounds[/b] - Everybody loves backgrounds, and we're sure you do too! (We know we do!) So we'll have 'em ready for you soon!
[*] [b]Avatars[/b] - We've added Avatars to the Apollo4x Community Page! So go and try them out! Use the official game avatars to rep the Apollo4x game in the Community and in battle.[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/365420/Avatar/List](View them here)[/url]
[/list]
We hope you are all excited about the new community elements we've brought to the table!

Thanks on behalf of the team for all your support!

Signing off,
The Raccoon

PS: If you want to use my favorite new avatar, click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/365420/Avatar/Preview/2]here[/url]

notes.title: Update: v1.2 released, changes to manual
notes.content:
Version 1.2 is live.

Fixes:
Monopolization allowing double-sale of goods
Flexible convoy not refunding spent fleet on undo
Champion no longer missing in action during combat

Manual has been updated slightly, and re-homed to permanent URL.  

We're working on v1.3 now :-)
